LESSON: KENYAN FOLK SONGS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.9: Kenyan Folk Songs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Kenyan Folk Songs
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is the role of folk songs in Kenyan society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. classify folk songs in Kenyan communities
2. perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques
3. appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: classify folk songs in Kenyan communities

Teach

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques

• Listen/read the idea.

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: classify folk songs in Kenyan communities
• Model 2: perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques
• Model 3: appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: classify folk songs in Kenyan communities
2. Practise: perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques
3. Practise: appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Kenyan Folk Songs.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the role of folk songs in Kenyan society?
2. How can performances of Kenyan folk songs be made interesting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• classify folk songs in Kenyan communities
• perform a folksong from a Kenyan community with appropriate techniques
• appreciate folk songs performance as means of cultural preservation

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
